_readme: Declared activation state of each production disaster-recovery capability, and the scheduled lanes that monitor it. A lane reads this to decide whether its subject is supposed to exist yet, so a capability that was never deployed cannot masquerade as a capability that just broke. Every lane also proves the declaration against the live runtime on each run, so a stale `not-activated` cannot silently blind the monitor. tests/invariants/dr-activation.spec.ts pins this file against the workflows and the scheduled-workflow watchdog manifest.

production-wal-archive.summary: Continuous WAL archiving from production PostgreSQL to object storage via WAL-G.
production-wal-archive.activationEvidence: aqua-postgres reports archive_mode=on (SHOW archive_mode). Running the WAL-G image is not activation: production carries that image in both states, and this state alone sets archive_mode and the healthcheck contract through docker-compose.droplet.yml (pinned by tests/invariants/wal-archive-activation.spec.ts).
production-wal-archive.whyNotActivated: Production runs the WAL-G derivative image (infrastructure/docker/Dockerfile.postgres-walg) with archive_mode=off, because archiving has no destination: the Spaces bucket, WAL-G principal and encryption key belong to plan phase BR-1 (see production-logical-backup) and were never provisioned. Archiving without them retains every WAL segment until the disk fills, which is what happened between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-02 (INFRA-CRITICAL-195). Activation belongs to plan phase BR-3: set this state to active.

production-logical-backup.summary: Nightly WAL-G base backup plus GPG-encrypted pg_dump companion to DigitalOcean Spaces, with signed run evidence.
production-logical-backup.activationEvidence: The production-backup environment resolves every secret in the backup-runtime and evidence-publisher profiles (tools/scripts/database/assert-backup-secrets.sh).
production-logical-backup.whyNotActivated: None of the twelve Spaces/WAL-G/GPG/evidence secrets has ever been provisioned on the repository or in any environment; see .github/provisioned-secrets.json. Minting those credentials is an operator act and belongs to plan phase BR-1.
